0022600181.text: The Rockets (6-1, 3-0 at home) are 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and 2nd in the West, while the Timberwolves (4-3) sit 10th in the West and are 4th in the Northwest, 1 game back. Houston will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was on April 10, 2026, in Houston, when the Rockets lost 136-132; the Rockets lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series.
